pr_title: [JSON] Pass aditional details request for GetDirectory/videos
pr_body:
## Description
When requesting `Files.GetDirectory` using smartplaylists additional properties like `cast`, `uniqueid`, etc are completely ignored. This PR makes sure that if the type is `videos` we correctly passthrough the requested properties as a `CFIleItemList` property used later in the chain instead of `VideoDbDetailsNone`

## Motivation and context
Fix https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/issues/21287

## How has this been tested?
Runtime tested

## What is the effect on users?
Fix the bug report
pr_comments:
purpose of the json-api patch number is to let consumers know when the internal implementation of a method has been changed.
https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/blob/3f3a3c9484ac9eef1b8d13400cd5bee987233753/xbmc/interfaces/json-rpc/schema/methods.json#L34
i think it needs a bump to JSONRPC_VERSION 12.10.1 here

Yes JSON API patch  bump required. 

But also because of the hierarchial nature of JSON API version numbering, and we have made changes to the API that have not been backported, despite being a fix we are unable to backport thus.
@rmrector will this fix allow you to add downloading actors images in Artwork Dump?

Opted to decouple the private `CVideoLibrary::RequiresAdditionalDetails` into two methods, placing the mask logic into a public getter `CVideoLibrary::GetDetailsFromJsonParameters`. Since there is no place for this in utils and FileOperations already include the VideoLibrary header at least we avoid code duplication and keep it scoped to the VideoLibrary stuff.
Bumped the json-rpc patch version as requested

> @rmrector will this fix allow you to add downloading actors images in Artwork Dump?

No, AD doesn't use smart playlists or XSP.
@enen92 Thx, working great for Movies... Can this be extended to TVshows & Episodes?
done in https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/pull/21316, please check if there's still something missing
